page.overview:
Who is Cruestati?

The Vampire Cruestati emerged victorious in his confrontation with his mortal enemy, the witch hunter Werner Weischbach, atop the Reikwater Falls. Though Weischbach perished, his rapier remained -- a lingering symbol of his unfinished crusade.
